prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent game animation sprite sheet based EXACTLY on the attached boss artwork.
Reference/edit target: the supplied image is the complete character design; preserve its central great five-pointed ivory crystal star, gold celestial crown, smaller stars, wing-shaped constellations and orbital filaments. Do not redesign it.
Produce an animation sprite sheet: exactly 8 frames in a strict uniform 4 columns by 2 rows grid, read left to right then next row. Landscape canvas 2048x1024 or same 2:1 ratio. Each frame fits entirely inside its own square cell with at least 10% transparent margin, centered on the exact same fixed anchor and same scale. NO grid lines or labels.
Animation: a seamless gentle floating/wafting loop and delicate twinkling highlights. Frame1 neutral, frame2 softly tilts 1 degree left and rises slightly, frame3 rises a little more with peripheral star filaments swaying left, frame4 eases toward center, frame5 neutral slightly high, frame6 tilts 1 degree right and lowers, frame7 soft peripheral sway right, frame8 returns close to frame1. Very subtle, no aggressive stretching or attack. Tiny gold glints brighten/dim on existing star tips in a progression; no large explosions, no new orbiting objects. Keep the central star solid and every satellite star's identity.
All artwork is same beautifully painted 2D fantasy RPG storybook style, precise engraved gold and ivory crystal. Genuine transparent background, no black or colored rectangle, no scene, no floor, no shadows under feet, no text, no numbers, no border, no watermark. All eight silhouettes fully within their cells, no clipping or touching adjacent cells.

Edit the provided animation sheet to fix ONLY its spacing and cropping. Preserve the same eight poses and exact character design. The sheet is a 4-column by 2-row grid. EVERY character must be significantly smaller: reduce each character to 65% of its current width/height within its own equal-size square cell. Center each complete character within its cell. Leave wide fully transparent gutters on all four sides of every character, at least 15% of cell width on left/right and 12% of cell height on top/bottom. No crystal tips, star glows, or orbital rings may touch any cell edge or neighboring character. Restore any cropped outer tips to the complete original character shape. Keep all 8 frames exactly the same scale and anchor. Transparent canvas 2:1 ratio. Exactly eight characters in strict 4x2 uniform grid, no added art, no text, no lines, no background. Subtle sway and glints already shown remain.
review: Initial crowded sheet rejected; final separated cells selected.
